description: Source file implementing XPU device management and enumeration for Intel GPUs using SYCL, including device initialization, property retrieval, and device context handling.

classes.name: DevicePool
classes.description: Holds the list of SYCL devices and the shared context for XPU device management.

methods.name: enumDevices
methods.description: Enumerates available GPU devices, prioritizing dGPU over iGPU, based on platform and device info.

methods.name: initGlobalDevicePoolState
methods.description: Initializes the device pool, enumerates devices, and sets up the default context, with warnings for unsupported devices.

methods.name: initDevicePoolCallOnce
methods.description: Ensures device pool initialization occurs only once.

methods.name: initDeviceProperties
methods.description: Populates device properties for a given device index.
